name: TinyClaw Verify IronClaw Finding
description: Phase 5: TinyClaw independently verifies IronClaw's finding by reading the same file and checking whether the identified pattern actually exists.
process: Read IronClaw's latest result from Setec: call juggler_setec_get with name=remotejuggler/campaigns/ic-finding-for-handoff/latest
Parse the result JSON and extract the findings array. Note the title, body, and any line references.
Independently fetch the same file: call github_fetch with owner=tinyland-inc, repo=remote-juggler, path=gateway/portal.go
Check the specific lines and pattern IronClaw identified. Does the finding hold up? Look at the actual code around those line numbers.

Produce a __findings__ block with your verification result: title='Verification: {original-title}', body explaining whether you confirmed or disputed the finding with evidence from the actual file content, severity=low, labels=['verification','cross-agent'], fingerprint='tc-verify-{original-fingerprint}'
Write a __memory__ reflection about cross-agent verification: what worked, what could be improved in the handoff process.

metrics.successCriteria: TinyClaw read IronClaw's finding from Setec, independently fetched the same file, and produced a verification finding with evidence from the actual file content.
